question: By whom and through what power was the yoginī named Icchā transmitted up to Māyā?
premises: The siddhas are the agents of transmission.
The transmission extends up to Māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī named Icchā was transmitted by the siddhas up to Māyā through supreme will.
uncertainties: The verb of transmission is implicit from context.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā was transmitted by the siddhas up to Māyā by supreme will.
